description: Edge's GatewayTrustBundleCreate request schema (openapi.yaml components.schemas.GatewayTrustBundleCreate), generated from ferrum-edge/ferrum-edge openapi.yaml at v0.9.21 (f9915358c8032214f4034a17c28cdf72d14006c3) with every component it references. id.description: Optional. Defaults to the authenticated `X-Ferrum-Namespace` value; it is never derived from a `namespace` field in the body.

revision.description: Expected current revision for optimistic concurrency on update. Ignored on create, and never stored — the store assigns the revision from its durable change sequence.

GatewayTrustBundleSet.description:
SPIFFE trust material for gateway trust-bundle resources (issue #3727),
in the same shape the mesh configuration model uses. Bounded on
admission: at most 16 X.509 authorities and 16 JWT authorities per
bundle, at most 256 federated bundles (derived from
`MAX_MESH_REMOTE_CLUSTERS`), at most 16 KiB per authority, and at most
512 KiB for the encoded value as a whole. Each X.509 authority must
parse as a certificate that consumes the complete entry, and each JWT
authority's `public_key_pem` must parse as a public key the JWT-SVID
validator can actually use (SPKI `PUBLIC KEY` PEM or a SPIFFE-federation
JWK object).

TrustBundle.description:
One trust domain's authorities. Every `x509_authorities` entry must be
valid base64 AND parse as an X.509 certificate; every
`jwt_authorities.public_key_pem` must parse as a public key the JWT-SVID
validator can actually use — either an SPKI `PUBLIC KEY` PEM or a
SPIFFE-federation JWK object, matching `TrustBundleSet`. At least one
authority is required.

public_key_pem.description:
SPKI `PUBLIC KEY` PEM, or a SPIFFE-federation JWK object
preserved verbatim from a JWKS document. Both are proved by
running the real parser, so a private-key paste, a truncated
body, or an unsupported key type is rejected.
